exposure: PRONTO training (simulation-based low-cost obstetric and neonatal emergency and team training program)
cohort: The participants were obstetric and neonatal care providers in 24 public hospitals in Mexico.
finding: The PRONTO intervention significantly reduced the incidence of cesarean sections and showed a temporary reduction in neonatal mortality, but had no significant impact on maternal complications.
mod_finding: PRONTO training significantly reduced the incidence of cesarean sections by 21% over 12 months.
